title: Authentic Gooey Korean Rhubarb Wrap
description: A traditional Chungcheong-style dish featuring rhubarb and ssam-wrap, perfect for a solo dinner, this recipe is gluten-free-friendly and served on a wooden board.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger to make the sauce.
Add the cut rhubarb to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Let the rhubarb mixture marinate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the marinated rhubarb to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until the rhubarb is tender and caramelized, about 20 minutes.
While the rhubarb is cooking, prepare the ssam wrap by rinsing the leaves and patting them dry with paper towels.
To assemble the wraps, place a few pieces of the cooked rhubarb onto the center of a ssam leaf, then sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and a pinch of salt.
Fold the ssam leaf over the filling to form a wrap, and serve immediately.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients to make additional wraps.
